name: Hortus Malabaricus
locations: Nedumpura, Cheruthuruthy, Thrissur district (about 5-6 km from Shoranur Junction)
summary: Hortus Malabaricus Botanical Garden and Research Institute is a roughly 27-acre garden at Nedumpura near Cheruthuruthy, inspired by the 17th-century botanical work Hortus Malabaricus compiled under Dutch governor Hendrik van Rheede. Visitors walk brick-paved paths through themed plant collections and a seasonal-plants conservatory, with cultural programmes such as Kutiyattam held in the grounds.
highlights: Garden inspired by the 17th-century Hortus Malabaricus, which documents Malabar plants
Themed plant collections and a conservatory of seasonal plants referenced in the book
Garden paths, pavilions and water features across about 27 acres (per press and site)
Opened in 2025 near Cheruthuruthy, close to Shoranur
Hosts workshops and performances such as the Kutiyattam festival programme, plus on-site stay
